clinicalPearls: PTHrP hypercalcaemia pairs with squamous; SIADH pairs with small cell
Pancoast tumour causes Horner syndrome and ulnar hand wasting
Adenocarcinoma is commonest in non smokers and peripherally located
Small cell cancer metastasises earliest and is rarely surgical
reference.pathophysiology: Tobacco carcinogens and driver mutations transform bronchial or alveolar epithelium through stepwise genetic damage including TP53 and RB loss in small cell disease. Neuroendocrine differentiation enables ectopic hormone secretion, while high growth fraction explains rapid doubling, early dissemination and initial chemosensitivity.
additionalDifferentials: Small cell versus non small cell management
Squamous versus adenocarcinoma site and secretions
additionalInvestigations: CT guided or bronchoscopic biopsy by tumour location
PET CT with mediastinal sampling for staging
Molecular panel and PD L1 testing in non small cell disease
